reviewTitle: Oh my previous review was erased
reviewText:
BBB complaint filed since meta/facebook support refuses to cooperate and chooses to non respond a complaint via email. 
Hyper personalized content seems to be going rampant now 
Meta is now using data obtained from “research” through a job I applied for to continue the retaliatory behavior and has completely removed any actual training, boundaries, and restrictions set by pelting me with racist and content targeting my disability. 

This has escalated into app retaliation lockouts from multiple social media accounts. 

And now I can’t reset my account password even though I’ve been logged in for weeks. Strange because this function doesn’t affect anyone else I know. Wild the amount of retaliation is just blatantly obvious at this point. 


More algorithmic abuse and manipulation. Including race rage baiting, targeting, blacks, Hispanics, Asians and Pacific Islanders. Targeting and antagonizing users on the platform. As well as use of dark patterns to falsely generate ad revenue. Not a good look for shareholders.

Ah now in retaliation to my recent update I’m just being spammed with thirst traps and irrelevant interests. 

I highly recommend the company review who they have in leadership that is pushing this behavior on to end users. 

The abuse continues as I recently made another concern about missing photos from my profile along with the strange shadow banning of accounts and removal of posts without notice. 

The issue persists where retaliatory behaviors in app continue to happen when leaving reviews like this. 

Meta is using shell access to retaliate against end users for raising these concerns, including cyber attacks against personal devices without app installation or web access. 

Was blasted with over ten minutes of cop reels when training the algorithm to not show this content due to past trauma. Facebooks platform retaliated against this and showed excessive reels back to back.

Annnnnd now I’m being harassed through hyper personalized content again. As well as deleted one of my accounts, again… seriously? This is outright abusive.

So again i recommend contacting your senator and encouraging them to hold companies accountable to these forms of abuse/manipulation.

It’s crazy to me the narrative this company tries to spin on people.  Not to mention the targeting of people who have disabilities and antagonizing them with hyper personalized abuse content. 

This abuse of tech is disgusting.

As more retaliation from the app continues, dark patterns and phantom clicks, continue as well. 

Shortly after my account was deleted without my input nor consent and I am being forced to do biometric verification.
